summary: Tobolsk Remezov Airport (RMZ) serves the historic city of Tobolsk in Tyumen Oblast, Western Siberia, Russia. The airport is named after Semyon Remezov, the renowned 17th-18th century Siberian architect and historian closely tied to Tobolsk's heritage. It functions as a medium-sized regional airport supporting travel to one of Siberia's oldest and most culturally significant cities.
faqs:
Q: What is Tobolsk Remezov Airport primarily used for?
A: The airport primarily serves regional domestic flights, connecting Tobolsk with major Russian cities and supporting both passenger travel and local industry.

Q: Which airlines operate at Tobolsk Remezov Airport?
A: The airport has historically been served by Russian regional carriers, though schedules and operators may vary by season.

Q: When is the best time to fly into Tobolsk?
A: Summer months (June to August) offer the most reliable weather conditions, while winter flights can be affected by heavy Siberian snowfall.

Q: Is Tobolsk worth visiting as a tourist destination?
A: Yes, Tobolsk is one of Siberia's most historic cities, featuring the Tobolsk Kremlin, ancient monasteries, and significant cultural landmarks.
transport_tips: The airport is located a short drive from the city center, and taxis or pre-arranged transfers are the most convenient way to reach Tobolsk. Public bus services occasionally connect the airport to central locations but run on limited schedules. Renting a car in advance is recommended for those planning to explore the surrounding Tyumen Oblast region.
local_tip: Bring warm clothing year-round, as Western Siberia experiences dramatic temperature swings, and always confirm your return flight in advance, as regional Russian airports sometimes have last-minute schedule changes.
